description: List live catalog entities (captures, collections, materializations, tests) the user can read, with connector + last-publication metadata. Optionally filter by a catalog-name prefix and spec_type. Estuary control-plane view live_specs_ext. PostgREST: GET /live_specs_ext.

name_prefix.description: Filter to catalog names starting with this prefix (PostgREST like.<prefix>* wildcard).

name: estuary_list_catalog
title: List catalog entities
